industry_knowledge.evidence: Slide 6: "California DTC brand est. 2022 by founder Bob, named for his dog Puck; ~145K monthly visits, 11-50 employees [S1][S6]" plus Slide 5 product specifics "Labrador Pro (~$1,399), Boxer ST, Corgi, Husky trike" and "UL 2849/2271 certified" - strong company facts with dates, but no competitor is ever named; the 'position' is only an inferred category whitespace.

business_opportunity.evidence: Slide 4: "PUCKIPUPPY's product wins - its delivery journey loses buyers. 11% of 500 reviews are 1-star; ~68% of those cite shipping damage, assembly, app issues, or support" - a specific structural problem (last-mile delivery leak on a $1.4K DTC ticket), and Slide 7 gives SMART objectives ("90 attributed orders... 400 test-ride signups... cut damage/support-driven 1-star share from ~68%... to under 50%").

research.evidence: Slide 9: "keyword-coded analysis of 500 public Judge.me reviews incl. 1-star deep-dive [R1][R2]; digital shelf/price audit of 6 sources [R4][R6]" plus Slide 10 finding->decision mapping. strategy.evidence: Slide 11: "Positioning: 'the ebike that arrives ready' - own the delivery-experience gap no competitor claims [R1][R6]" built on coded findings, with the Arrive Ready insert + setup concierge + live trust dashboard (Slide 13) as the mechanism. Strong and differentiated, but the PESO mix and creator program are copyable, and the 'un-copyable' element (publishing live claim-resolution data) depends on company cooperation that is still an unconfirmed assumption [A5].
strategy.fix: Make the un-copyable asset explicit: the trust dashboard publishing real damage-claim resolution times requires operational data no competitor exposes - argue that as the moat, not just a channel, and secure company sign-off on data access before the pitch.

activities.evidence: Slide 16: "Wk1: Arrive Ready inserts live... Wk2-4: 6 test-ride pop-ups + 8 Dog Pack creator posts... Wk5-6: second test-ride wave... budget.evidence: Slide 17: "Total $21,000: media $8,000 [A4]; creators 8 x $800 [A6]; events 8 x $300 [A7]; inserts [A9]; tools [A10]; contingency [A11]" - lines sum correctly (8,000+6,400+2,400+1,200+400+2,600=21,000), funnel math to $102.6K revenue, GP-based ROI ~56%, honest conservative case ("~43 orders -> -$7K, offset by 800 captures (~$12K list value)"), and margin sensitivity 25%/40%. impact.evidence: Slide 18: "O1: attributed orders - Shopify code + UTM report, weekly; target 90...
